verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships through a Claude Code plugin marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace`), Devin and Antigravity plugin channels, and git-clone installs. A hands-on probe copied a skill into the project-local `./.claude/skills/` folder, so the files could be committed to the repo. All of these channels are documented as per-user installs, though, and there is no documented team-wide distribution, and each harness needs its own install. missing for 10: documented team- or org-wide rollout (e.g. project-scoped plugin config that installs for every teammate), first-party guidance on committing skills to a shared project repo, single cross-harness team install, independent corroboration of team distribution.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project

citations.quote:
Add this marketplace to Claude Code:

/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace
This release also adds a native plugin manifest for the Antigravity Marketplace
`devin plugins install obra/superpowers` now works, and skills auto-trigger at session start.
Installation differs by harness. If you use more than one, install Superpowers separately for each one.
